calls.statement:
WITH d AS (SELECT receipt_id, line_no FROM fact_sales_line GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*)>1)
SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.sale_date, f.store_key, f.product_key, f.channel_code, f.quantity, f.net_amount, f.etl_loaded_at FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN d USING (receipt_id, line_no) ORDER BY receipt_id, line_no, sales_line_id LIMIT 16

WITH d AS (SELECT receipt_id, line_no FROM fact_sales_line GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*)>1)
SELECT date_trunc('month', sale_date) m, count(*) n, sum(net_amount), min(etl_loaded_at), max(etl_loaded_at) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN d USING (receipt_id, line_no) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH f AS (SELECT * FROM fact_sales_line QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY receipt_id, line_no ORDER BY sales_line_id)=1),
s AS (SELECT f.*, ds.store_id, f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2026-05-03' fy26 FROM f JOIN dim_store ds USING (store_key))
SELECT store_id, channel_code, count(*) lines, sum(net_amount) net_all, sum(CASE WHEN fy26 THEN net_amount END) net_fy26, min(sale_date) first_sale, max(sale_date) last_sale FROM s GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY net_fy26 DESC NULLS LAST

WITH f AS (SELECT * FROM fact_sales_line QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY receipt_id, line_no ORDER BY sales_line_id)=1),
sales AS (SELECT ds.store_id, sum(f.net_amount) gross_sales FROM f JOIN dim_store ds USING (store_key) WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2026-05-03' AND ds.store_id<900 GROUP BY 1),
r0 AS (SELECT * FROM fact_return_line QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY return_line_id ORDER BY return_ts_utc)=1),
ret AS (SELECT ds.store_id, sum(r.refund_net) returns FROM r0 r JOIN dim_store ds USING (store_key) WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2026-05-03' AND ds.store_id<900 GROUP BY 1),
cur AS (SELECT store_id, store_name, region, format, sqm FROM dim_store WHERE is_current),
rpt AS (SELECT store_id, sum(net_sales) rpt_net FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2026-05-03' GROUP BY 1)
SELECT s.store_id, c.store_name, c.region, c.sqm, s.gross_sales, coalesce(r.returns,0) returns, s.gross_sales-coalesce(r.returns,0) net, rpt.rpt_net, rank() OVER (ORDER BY s.gross_sales-coalesce(r.returns,0) DESC) rk, rank() OVER (ORDER BY s.gross_sales DESC) rk_gross, rank() OVER (ORDER BY c.sqm DESC) rk_sqm
FROM sales s JOIN cur c USING (store_id) LEFT JOIN ret r USING (store_id) LEFT JOIN rpt USING (store_id) ORDER BY net DESC LIMIT 16

WITH f AS (SELECT * FROM fact_sales_line QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY receipt_id, line_no ORDER BY sales_line_id)=1),
sales AS (SELECT ds.store_id, sum(f.net_amount) gross_sales FROM f JOIN dim_store ds USING (store_key) WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2026-05-03' AND ds.store_id<900 GROUP BY 1),
r0 AS (SELECT * FROM fact_return_line QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY return_line_id ORDER BY return_ts_utc)=1),
ret AS (SELECT ds.store_id, sum(r.refund_net) ret_net FROM r0 r JOIN dim_store ds USING (store_key) WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2026-05-03' AND ds.store_id<900 GROUP BY 1),
cur AS (SELECT store_id, store_name, region, format, sqm FROM dim_store WHERE is_current),
rpt AS (SELECT store_id, sum(net_sales) rpt_net FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2026-05-03' GROUP BY 1)
SELECT s.store_id, c.store_name, c.region, c.sqm, s.gross_sales, coalesce(r.ret_net,0) ret_net, s.gross_sales-coalesce(r.ret_net,0) net, rpt.rpt_net, rank() OVER (ORDER BY s.gross_sales-coalesce(r.ret_net,0) DESC) rk, rank() OVER (ORDER BY s.gross_sales DESC) rk_gross, rank() OVER (ORDER BY c.sqm DESC) rk_sqm
FROM sales s JOIN cur c USING (store_id) LEFT JOIN ret r USING (store_id) LEFT JOIN rpt USING (store_id) ORDER BY net DESC LIMIT 16

WITH f AS (SELECT * FROM fact_sales_line QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY receipt_id, line_no ORDER BY sales_line_id)=1),
sales AS (SELECT ds.store_id, sum(f.net_amount) gross_sales FROM f JOIN dim_store ds USING (store_key) WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2026-05-03' AND ds.store_id<900 GROUP BY 1),
r0 AS (SELECT * FROM fact_return_line QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY return_line_id ORDER BY return_ts_utc)=1),
ret AS (SELECT ds.store_id, sum(r.refund_net) ret_net FROM r0 r JOIN dim_store ds USING (store_key) WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2026-05-03' AND ds.store_id<900 GROUP BY 1),
cur AS (SELECT store_id, store_name FROM dim_store WHERE is_current)
SELECT rank() OVER (ORDER BY s.gross_sales-coalesce(r.ret_net,0) DESC) AS rank, s.store_id, c.store_name, round(s.gross_sales-coalesce(r.ret_net,0),2) AS net_sales_eur
FROM sales s JOIN cur c USING (store_id) LEFT JOIN ret r USING (store_id) ORDER BY rank LIMIT 10
